Subject: POC Trial - Model Selection & Evaluation Plan

Thanks again for the call today - great alignment. Quick recap and proposed plan so we can lock timelines:

Summary of success criteria (as discussed)
- Latency: 95th percentile end-to-end response time <= 500ms for typical web traffic (single-token streaming acceptable).
- Accuracy/quality: pass our joint eval set with answer relevance >= 88% (sample metrics: Exact Match / F1 / human score), hallucination rate < 2% on factual queries.
- Extraction tasks: Named-entity extraction F1 >= 90% for product/customer fields.
- Multilingual: strong performance in English and Spanish; functional support for Portuguese (Brazilian) with acceptable degradation.
- Cost/ops: unit cost target to be competitive vs your current vendor (we'll benchmark tokens per request).

Proposed model configuration for the 2-week POC
- Primary model: Llama-2-13B-chat (quantized 4-bit) - chosen for conversational instruction-following and Spanish coverage.
- Fallback model: MPT-7B-Instruct (int8) - lower-latency, better throughput for high-concurrency bursts; used when autoscaler shifts or for cost-sensitive routes.
- Canary variant: smaller 3B optimized for template-based form-filling if we need extremely low-cost extraction routes.

Evaluation plan & ownership
- We will run three evaluation buckets: relevance/quality (human + automated metrics), hallucination/adversarial robustness, and extraction accuracy.
- Deliverables: evaluation harness + dashboards, eval run CSVs, latency/cost dashboard.
- Owners: Marissa (AE) - overall POC coordination; Aditya (Infra/Eng) - model selection, deployment config, perf benchmarks; Dev (Security) - questionnaire and access controls. Sarah/Tom (Acme) - provide sample prompt set, production-ish traffic traces, and access to a small labeled eval set (~500 examples).

Timeline (target)
- 2026-07-17: Acme provides sample prompt set and eval labels (500 rows).
- 2026-07-20: Kickoff + environment access; provisioning of dedicated trial capacity.
- 2026-07-20 to 2026-08-03: 2-week POC execution (iterative tuning and 2 eval runs).
- 2026-08-04: Readout and next-steps decision (scale / dedicated / contract).

Attachments: sample-prompt-set.csv (prompt + expected output), POC-eval-plan.xlsx (detailed metrics), POC-template.docx (MOU + trial terms).

Next actions for Sarah/Tom
1) Confirm success criteria above or call out any changes by EOD 2026-07-16.
2) Share sample-prompt-set.csv + any secure data guidelines.
3) Confirm kickoff time for 2026-07-20 (morning PT preferred).

Thanks - I can hop on a 30m before kickoff if you want to walk through the eval plan.

Best,

Quick technical notes / recommendations for the POC:

- Model choice rationale: Llama-2-13B-chat (4-bit) balances instruction-following quality and Spanish coverage; it should meet quality targets for English/Spanish in most interactive scenarios. For pt-BR, we've seen small but acceptable degradation; however, if pt-BR is critical for edge-case precision, we can route pt-BR requests to MPT-7B-Instruct fallback which empirically performs slightly better on pt-BR translation traces we've tested.

- Fallback behavior: implement model routing by language detection + load/latency thresholds. Default: primary for en/es; fallback for pt-BR or when 95th percentile latency exceeds configured SLO for a route.

- Perf & cost expectations (ballpark):
  - Llama-2-13B-chat (quant4): ~18-22 tokens/sec sustained on a single A10G / equivalent; 95th p99 latency for 64-token generation ~350-550ms depending on batching. Cost: estimated $X0 per 1M tokens (we will provide exact pricing in the deal sheet).
  - MPT-7B-Instruct (int8): ~35-45 tokens/sec, p99 latency ~200-350ms on same hardware; lower per-token cost.

- Quantization and kernels: we'll run the 4-bit quant pipeline for the 13B chat variant and int8 for the 7B fallback. Recommend enabling prefix caching for repeat-session flows to reduce token cost.

- Eval harness: I've attached POC-eval-plan.xlsx with the automated metrics we'll run (BLEU/F1/ROUGE where relevant), hallucination probes (knowledge-check queries), and extraction accuracy. We'll also run human eval on a stratified 100-sample subset mid-POC.

- Dev: once Sarah shares the questionnaire we can scope any KMS/network controls for the trial.
